items.source: PropertySource to be used as a placeholder in cases where an actual property source cannot be eagerly initialized at application context creation time. For example, a ServletContext-based property source must wait until the ServletContext object is available to its enclosing ApplicationContext. In such cases, a stub should be used to hold the intended default position/order of the property source, then be replaced during context refresh.
items.translation: `PropertySource` 用作占位符，在无法在应用程序上下文创建时急切初始化实际属性源的情况下使用。例如，基于 `ServletContext` 的属性源必须等待其包围的 `ApplicationContext` 中的 `ServletContext` 对象可用。在这种情况下，应使用一个存根来持有该属性源的预期默认位置/顺序，然后在上下文刷新期间将其替换。
